# Source fixtures

These are small public-content fragments captured on 2026-09-17 for parser tests. They are intentionally reduced to the notice/case fields needed by the tests and are never fetched by the default test suite.

- `china_jm_notice.html`: China-JM event notice extraction and evidence dates.
- `generic_notice.html`: generic university notice-list/detail parsing.
- `court_case.html`: Supreme People's Court case-detail parsing.
- `spp_case.html`: Supreme People's Procuratorate case-detail parsing.
- `law_update.html`: basic HTML law-update parsing.
